lines.zh: 我在村子里转，专挑没人的巷子
lines.en: I move through the village, keeping to empty alleys.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，手藏在斗篷里
lines.en: I walk the wall's base, hands hidden in my cloak.

lines.zh: 我从一家门口走到另一家
lines.en: I go from one doorway to the next.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，鞋底不着地
lines.en: I walk light, my soles barely touching.
Around the square; too many eyes there.

lines.zh: 我朝窗户里看了一眼，继续走
lines.en: I glance in a window and keep going.
I climb the low wall over a hay bale.
They do not welcome me; I know.

lines.zh: 我背着的东西走起来会响，我按住它
lines.en: My bundle rattles as I walk; I hold it still.
I round the corner and stop to listen
This path is easier at night.
I head toward that house on the edge.
I crouch under the eaves, waiting for dark.
My hood is pulled low.
I am counting how many live in this house.
The lamp at the door is still lit.
My fingers move inside my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这村子不算富，但能拿的不少
lines.en: Not a rich village, but plenty to take.

lines.zh: 我不偷穷人，只偷不在意的人
lines.en: I do not rob the poor, only those who will not miss it.
Wind comes down the alley.

lines.zh: 我把东西挪了挪，藏得更严
lines.en: I shift my bundle, hiding it better.
I do not act; I only watch.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽往上抬了一点
lines.en: I lift my hood a little.
No weapon in your hands; good.
Do you live here?

lines.zh: 我看你的腰带，不看你的眼
lines.en: I look at your belt, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你戴着那顶南瓜，我就当没看见你
lines.en: Wearing that pumpkin, I will pretend not to see you.
Can we go our separate ways?
Do not call anyone and I will not run.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，手还在袖子里
lines.en: I step back, hand still in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一带我熟，你拦不住我
lines.en: I know this area; you cannot corner me.

lines.zh: 别把我当成小偷，虽然我是
lines.en: Do not call me a thief, though I am one.

lines.zh: 我退了，捂着被撞的地方
lines.en: I back off, clutching the spot.
That was heavy; I remember it.
I press the wound and make no sound
My hood fell; I pick it up.
Blood drips from my sleeve.
I am done fighting; I am leaving.
This run was not worth it.
I step behind the wall and re-plan.
You are harsher than me; I admit it.
I remember your face.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，看起来能卖
lines.en: That in your hand looks sellable.

lines.zh: 我不抢你的，我等你放下
lines.en: I will not take it; I will wait for you to set it down.
What is that worth?
I reach out only to gauge it.

lines.zh: 你要是给我，我就不用动手
lines.en: Give it and I need not lift a hand.
I glance around; no one.
I smile once, and you miss it.
Not worth much; I am going.

lines.zh: 我把它捏在手里，很快放回
lines.en: I take it, then put it right back.

lines.zh: 下次别拿这么显眼的东西
lines.en: Do not carry such obvious things next time.
You bump me and I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 我肩上的东西掉了一件
lines.en: Something falls from my shoulder.
I had no intention of fighting you.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的兜帽掀了
lines.en: That knocked my hood back.
I squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先把东西护住
lines.en: We collide; I guard my bundle first.
You are stronger; I know.

lines.zh: 地上的土沾了我的衣角
lines.en: Dirt stains my hem.
I am backing off; do not follow.
I slip around to the other end of the alley.

lines.zh: 我们这种人，聚在一起会出事
lines.en: People like us together invite trouble.

lines.zh: 我和同伙只分东西，不分话
lines.en: My partner and I split goods, not words.
He keeps watch; I go in.
We split the take where no one is.
Whoever gets caught carries it alone.

lines.zh: 我们之间有规矩，不高声
lines.en: We have rules between us, and we keep them quiet.

lines.zh: 兜帽是我们唯一相同的衣服
lines.en: The hood is the only thing we share.

lines.zh: 今晚这户人家，两个人够了
lines.en: Two is enough for this house tonight.
He is quicker; I am steadier.

lines.zh: 分完这一趟，就各走各的
lines.en: After this run, we go our ways.
I pick it up and tuck it inside my coat.
This will fetch a few coins.
I check whether anyone is watching.

lines.zh: 我把它放进袋子，压得低
lines.en: I drop it in the bag, low down.

lines.zh: 这家人不会发现少了一件
lines.en: They will not notice one piece gone.
I weigh it; not heavy.
I take it and put it back.

lines.zh: 这东西太显眼，不好出手
lines.en: Too recognizable; hard to move.
I take it and leave a coin in trade.
I hide it under the hay.

lines.zh: 你手里那把武器，我要了
lines.en: That weapon in your hand; I want it.
You turned your back; perfect.
What is not yours, I take.
I have my eye on your belt.
Your guard is too loose.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看退路
lines.en: I check your hands, then my way out.
You will call for help, so I must be quick.
This run is no great risk.
I do not fight people; I take things.
Hold still; I will not hurt you.
I have checked both ends of the alley.
You are carrying something valuable.
I show half a shoulder from behind the wall
This is not robbery; it is borrowing.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我立刻走
lines.en: Set it down and I leave at once.

lines.zh: 我在心里数着你的步子
lines.en: I count your steps in my head

lines.zh: 我跟着你，隔着半条巷子
lines.en: I follow half an alley behind.
You speed up, so do I.

lines.zh: 你每回一次头，我就贴墙
lines.en: Every time you look back, I press to the wall.
I wait for you to set it down.
At the alley's end, a wall
I will not fight you; I will follow you.
Your things jingle.
I am counting your purse.

lines.zh: 你进屋子之前，最好先看看身后
lines.en: Before you go in, look behind you.

lines.zh: 屋檐下很暗，我就在那儿
lines.en: The eave is dark; that is where I am.
I slip behind the next house's wall.

lines.zh: 我不会一直等，我也有别人要照顾
lines.en: I will not wait forever; I have others to look after.

lines.zh: 你把东西塞进怀里的样子，我都看见了
lines.en: I saw you tuck it into your coat.
I dislike using a knife.
Go on and there will be no one around.
I pull my hood lower.

lines.zh: 这家人睡了，街上是我的
lines.en: The household is asleep; the street is mine.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很响，我不用看
lines.en: Your steps are loud; I need not look.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的钱袋味
lines.en: I can smell the purse on you
The last house; here.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，把你的武器夺了
lines.en: I reach out and take your weapon.
What I take, I know how to use.

lines.zh: 我只推你一下，不想伤人
lines.en: I only shove you; I do not want to hurt anyone.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的手腕上
lines.en: That hit your wrist.
You let go; it is mine.
I retreat with your sword.
I do not chase; I take it and go.
You called out; I must be quicker.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，骨头生疼
lines.en: I block, and my arm aches.
Stop chasing; you will not catch me.
That was only to make you let go.
I stuff it in my coat and run.
The alley is narrow; you cannot swing.
I step on a crate and go over the wall.

lines.zh: 你还站着，那就再来一次
lines.en: Still standing? Then once more.

lines.zh: 我不恋战，这是我的活法
lines.en: I never linger in a fight; that is how I live.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽拉下来挡住脸
lines.en: I pull my hood down over my face.

lines.zh: 你丢了东西，我也丢了时间
lines.en: You lost a thing, and I lost time.
This run is mine.

lines.zh: 下次别把武器举得那么高
lines.en: Next time, do not hold your weapon so high.
I know these village alleys well.
The wind carries the smell of homes.
I come around from behind a wall.

lines.zh: 没人欢迎我，但我还是来了
lines.en: No one welcomes me, yet here I am.
I am looking for a house with an unlocked door.
I pull my hood low and walk the village road.

lines.zh: 兜里有几枚铜币，先垫着
lines.en: A few coins in my pocket, for now.

lines.zh: 我在屋檐下站了一会儿
lines.en: I stand under the eaves a while.
People here sleep early.

lines.zh: 我踩了几步，确认没有狗
lines.en: I test my steps to make sure no dog is about.
The night is right for one run.

lines.zh: 我数了数有几扇窗还亮着
lines.en: I count the windows still lit.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的斗篷，我拍着跑
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak; I slap it and run.

lines.zh: 我从墙上摔下去，落地滚了半圈
lines.en: I fall off the wall and roll.

lines.zh: 水灌进兜帽里，我往上挣
lines.en: Water fills my hood; I struggle up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到巷子另一头
lines.en: The blast throws me to the far end of the alley.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩，我拔不掉
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I cannot pull it out.

lines.zh: 一股力抓住我，我动不了
lines.en: A force seizes me and I cannot move.
Days without food; I cannot run.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我整个人一抖
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I jolt.
No alley below, only void.
